FINDING A — ACCEPT
VALIDITY: Confirmed on frozen source. Manager.role.md lines 69-72 prompt says read reviewer_inbox, claim, act; no taskless start. Current effective Reviewer role v5 (blob 6f69911f5fc31b6face71fbc379aa3e9248e64dc; snapshot 331efc5195dd3f9cd440a417f9aee65a03839518) has no taskless branch and assumes yield_agent on a standing Reviewer task. ReviewWorkflow.fs:2742-2761 implements StartTasklessWork as an explicit exact-version, actor-bound transition from unassigned Parked/NeedsWork + Stopped to Working. Client/SignalR/Client.fs auto-activation is for Ready assigned work; Client.Tests/ReviewWorkflowTests.fs:3751-3815 verifies AgentInbox does not activate a taskless reviewer and explicit StartTasklessWork is required/actor-bound. ClaimBranchReview at ReviewWorkflow.fs:3564-3573 changes only the review record (Claimed, ReviewerId, version), not agent state. Planner REVIEWABLE_AGENT_STATES includes NeedsWork; claimed-resume gate is manager-heartbeat.mjs:379-385. Without taskless start, the reviewer remains NeedsWork/Stopped after claim/activity and can be re-reserved after the prior reservation is observed/released.
REPRODUCTION: Reviewer 1's immutable summary reports direct planner reproduction: UnclaimedFrozenReview, no launch, no launch, then ClaimedReviewResume on a later tick. I independently checked the exact frozen lifecycle, prompt, planner gates and test contract. Summary reports node --test scripts/tests/manager-heartbeat.test.mjs exit 0 (36/36) and git diff --check exit 0. Server.Tests job c48b552c837b4574a6eca91b3c85cbb5 was still Running in that summary; it is not treated as passed and is not required for this state-machine finding.
SCOPE: Original spec explicitly says allow operation without standing reviewer assignments, dispatch eligible unclaimed reviews, resume a reviewer's runnable claimed review, preserve canonical claim ownership and capacity/deduplication. Not a net-new objective.
IMPACT: With Manager enabled, a taskless reviewer launched and prompted as written can claim and produce attributed activity while remaining Stopped. Once activity is observed and the reservation released, a later tick can launch a second session for the same reviewer/claim. This can duplicate sessions and undercount reviewer capacity. Conflicting writes/decisions are possible downstream, not observed; versioned review mutations may reject stale writes. Requires the approved live scheduling path, which is currently disabled/unconfigured.
PRACTICALITY / AUTHORIZED SCOPE: Update generated launch prompt and canonical Reviewer instructions with a conditional taskless path: reviewer reads own AgentInbox for exact version, immediately self-calls StartTasklessWork before reviewer_inbox/claim/review work, and uses YieldTasklessWork on completion, no eligible review, or block/interruption rather than yield_agent on a nonexistent standing task. Preserve standing-task/manual reviewer lifecycle, claim ownership, actor/version fencing, and Manager caller/reviewer-subject separation. Add end-to-end launch/start/claim/activity/multiple-tick regression proving Working is counted and no duplicate reservation occurs until yield. Inbox auto-activation, ClaimBranchReview state mutation, or Manager impersonation are not valid alternatives. Corrective Work may be created in this scope; this adjudicator does not create/assign it.
FINDING B — ACCEPT
VALIDITY: Confirmed on frozen source. ReviewWorkflow.fs:2763-2781 makes YieldTasklessWork transition unassigned Working to Parked/Stopped. Planner manager-heartbeat.mjs:20 allows only Ready, NeedsWork, Free; claimed-resume lines 379-385 rejects Parked, and unclaimed dispatch lines 407-415 requires NeedsWork/Free + Stopped. The claim remains open because yield changes the agent record, not the review. Manager docs describe available taskless reviewer as NeedsWork/Stopped and specify no automatic unpark path. set_agent_state is explicitly an administrative park/unpark control.
SCOPE: Original spec requires a reviewer with a runnable claimed review to resume and an available reviewer to receive eligible unclaimed demand, while separating execution from assignment/queue eligibility. Voluntary taskless yield must be distinct from explicit Operator park.
IMPACT: A taskless reviewer yielding with an outstanding runnable claim is suppressed as NoRunnableClaimedReview. After a completed review, Parked also prevents reuse for subsequent unclaimed demand. Without manual Operator unpark, automated queue progress stops for that reviewer. Preconditions are taskless yield and a subsequent runnable claim or unclaimed demand; no current live incident.
PRACTICALITY / AUTHORIZED SCOPE: Do not add all Parked agents to planner eligibility. Prefer successful voluntary YieldTasklessWork leaving NeedsWork/Stopped (available), reserving Parked for explicit administrative Operator stop. If changing generic taskless-yield semantics is unsuitable for other roles, add a typed durable taskless-yield disposition. Do not infer intent from free-text StateReason. Test claimed-review resume after yield, reuse after completed review, manual Park remaining ineligible, and blocked-claim wake only after dependency resolution. Preserve ownership, challenge gating, deduplication, capacity and Operator stop semantics. Corrective Work may be created in this scope; this adjudicator does not create/assign it.
FINAL: Accept A and Accept B as separate dispositions. No source/review document edits, corrective Work, integration, deployment, scheduler activation or live external effects.
